comment: Original BPM-synced beat-scatter effect inspired by performance beat-repeat tools. Div sets the slice grid; Pattern selects every, alternate, or syncopated slices; Type selects stutter, reverse, or quarter-shifted playback. The last captured division is transformed on selected grid cycles.
fxid_comment: 0x01E6. Unused by existing effect manifests and tools/effects_db.json at implementation time.

params.name: Div
params.comment: Scatter slice and grid length: 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, or 1/4 note. Long slices are capped at 32768 frames.

params.name: BPM
params.comment: Tempo in BPM; DSP range is 40-240.

params.name: Type
params.comment: Stutter repeats the first quarter of the captured slice; Reverse plays it backwards; Shift rotates its starting point by one quarter.

params.name: Pattern
params.comment: Every scatters each division, Alt scatters alternating divisions, Sync scatters alternating divisions with the opposite phase.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Blend between live input and the scattered slice.
